diagnostics.message: google_essential_contacts_contact.contact sets parent = local.folder.name, which resolves to google_folder.folder via a try()/count conditional. The contact can only be created once the folder exists, but because the reference is indirected through a local, the dependency on google_folder.folder is not captured. Add an explicit depends_on on google_folder.folder.
